_meta.role: Software Engineer, Embedded Systems/Firmware, Platforms and Devices

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT), NY, with hands-on firmware experience writing bare-metal C on STM32 and coordinating tasks under FreeRTOS. Built register-level embedded systems on resource constrained hardware, diagnosed integration failures through iterative testing across sensor, servo, and communication layers, and characterized performance and scaling behavior in distributed C/C++ systems.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove for hands-free cursor control, integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; debugged and resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

experience.title: Research Fellowship
bullets: Engineered a custom data pipeline for the BraTS 2020 multi-modal MRI dataset with medical imaging augmentation and batch-loading memory management for large-scale 3D volumetric inputs.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1) on a Cortex-M4 target on resource constrained hardware; achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver; verified in Proteus.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination on an STM32 embedded operating system; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing and OLED distance visualization.
Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override; used YOLOv8 on NVIDIA Jetson to detect and track objects, sending control commands to STM32.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Diagnosed and resolved 11 integration failures (false-positive detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture) through iterative testing across a three-layer distributed embedded pipeline; achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.
Implemented two-link inverse kinematics on Arduino in C++, driving five servos with range-gated contact detection over I2C.

projects.name: MPI Hodgkin-Huxley Neuron Simulation
bullets: Implemented distributed dendrite computations across MPI workers with synchronous soma updates on a SLURM-managed cluster, achieving up to 10.49x speedup with 12 processes.
Characterized scaling behavior across dendrite counts and compartment depths; diagnosed load imbalance effects causing up to 65% performance degradation under uneven work distribution.
